data.body: CROSS-EPIC COORDINATION from 69e8-af39-7886-4ee9 SC4: 69e8 extends the same three test-writer prompt files that d566 SC3 modifies (plugins/dso/agents/red-test-writer.md, plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md, fix-bug RED-phase prompt). 69e8 injects negative-examples-lookup.sh invocation + 'Project-specific learned patterns' block; d566 injects Rule 6/7 reference + intent-claim header schema. The two additions are non-conflicting (different sections of the prompts) but require merge-window coordination when both epics ship in overlapping sprints to avoid concurrent edits. Recommend: d566 lands first (provides Rule 6 schema), then 69e8 adds the negative-examples retrieval section.
